items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Yeah, I did. I did. Very nice person.

ctx.x: And he had to laugh. He was so comical. Louie had to laugh himself. Louie knew what he meant. He wasn't sure.
Louie knew what he meant. Did you know Joe's wife or...
Yeah, I did. I did. Very nice person. I don't know why she moved.
